purpose: Second-round structural refinement within the selected Human / tactile mnemonic family.
fixedGrammar: Three-second tactile sonic logo. Dry close mark at 0.00; second distinct mark at 0.45; a narrow tensioned-string filament travels from 0.55–1.75; contact reveals a compact warm woody, low-reed interval at 1.75; one fine upper resonance continues to 3.00. Intimate, restrained. No voice, beat, anthem, notification, whoosh or triumph.
